description: A named competition's applications with NO signal that broader performance signups are separate — the shape of the live calfurry post. Accepted trade-off (CON-31 round 2): prompts can only use knowledge inside the post, so an unsignalled named competition DOES set performances dates by default; the calfurry false-positive class is caught only when the post itself signals separate or upcoming broader signups (see con31-named-competition.json). Static-dated because the expected closes date comes from an absolute month-day in the text; once exampcon-2026 ends (2026-11-08) the edition falls out of upcoming_events() and the suite skips this fixture with a visible reason — refresh the dates then.

posts.text: Dance Competition applications are open now through September 5th!
